title: Tapered rod
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. Begin by drawing the first face, which consists of two loops. In the first loop, draw a line from the point (0.0, 0.7275) to (0.0179, 0.0143), then continue to (0.0321, 0.0), (0.0464, 0.0143), (0.0643, 0.7275), (0.0321, 0.75), and finally back to (0.0, 0.7275). For the second loop, draw a circle centered at (0.0321, 0.6071) with a radius of 0.0107. After completing the sketch, apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire sketch to adjust its size. Transform the scaled 2D sketch into a 3D model by rotating it with the Euler angles set to zero and translating it with the translation vector set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.0071 units in the direction of the normal, ensuring no extrusion occurs in the opposite direction. Finally, define a boolean operation to create a new solid body from the extruded sketch. The final dimensions of the tapered rod with a small circular hole are 0.0643 units in length, 0.75 units in width, and 0.0071 units in height.

import cadquery as cq

# Define the sketch
sketch = cq.Workplane("XY").moveTo(0.0, 0.7275).lineTo(0.0179, 0.0143).lineTo(0.0321, 0.0).lineTo(0.0464, 0.0143).lineTo(0.0643, 0.7275).lineTo(0.0321, 0.75).close()

# Add the circular hole
sketch = sketch.moveTo(0.0321, 0.6071).circle(0.0107)

# Extrude the sketch
extrusion = sketch.extrude(0.0071)

# Final model
r = extrusion

lanes.label: GLM-5.3 Flash (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

cx = 0.03215  # centerline in X
t = 0.0071    # thickness

# Tapered blade outline (top view): pointed tip at top (y=0.75),
# tapering down to a narrower pointed end at bottom (y=0)
r = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .moveTo(cx - 0.0155, 0.7335)
    .lineTo(cx, 0.75)          # top point
    .lineTo(cx + 0.0155, 0.7335)
    .lineTo(cx + 0.0145, 0.03) # taper down right side
    .lineTo(cx + 0.006, 0.012)
    .lineTo(cx, 0.0)           # bottom point
    .lineTo(cx - 0.006, 0.012)
    .lineTo(cx - 0.0145, 0.03) # taper up left side
    .close()
    .extrude(t)
)

# Hole near the wide end
r = (
    r.faces(">Z")
    .workplane()
    .center(0, -0.75 + 0.645 + 0.75 - 0.75)  # keep relative to origin
    .moveTo(0, 0.645 - 0.75)
    .circle(0.0075)
    .cutThruAll()
)

# Re-center: shift so bounding box starts near origin in X
r = r.translate((-cx, 0, 0))

lanes.label: Kimi K3 (high)
lanes.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Overall bounding-box dimensions
X = 0.0643
Y = 0.7500
Z = 0.0071
cx = X / 2.0

# Tapered flat leaf profile in XY, touching all bbox limits
pts = [
    (cx, 0.000),
    (cx + 0.009, 0.018),
    (cx + 0.016, 0.120),
    (cx + 0.024, 0.300),
    (cx + 0.030, 0.550),
    (cx + X / 2.0, 0.700),
    (cx + 0.022, 0.730),
    (cx, Y),
    (cx - 0.022, 0.730),
    (cx - X / 2.0, 0.700),
    (cx - 0.030, 0.550),
    (cx - 0.024, 0.300),
    (cx - 0.016, 0.120),
    (cx - 0.009, 0.018),
]

body = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .polyline(pts)
    .close()
    .extrude(Z)
)

# Through hole near the wide end
hole_d = 0.016
hole = (
    cq.Workplane("XY")
    .center(cx, 0.610)
    .circle(hole_d / 2.0)
    .extrude(Z + 0.002)
    .translate((0, 0, -0.001))
)

r = body.cut(hole)
